content.text: The redline validates cleanly. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: (c) ASSIGNMENT. Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent.
input.rationale: Two independent walk-away features. First, Section (c) (p0149) is a blanket prohibition on Licensee assignment with no affiliate or M&A/successor carve-out and no reasonableness standard on Licensor's consent, and the restriction is one-sided (nothing limits Licensor's assignment, including to our competitors). Second, Article XX(a) (p0134) makes the Agreement and all of our licenses terminate automatically on our Change of Control (asset sale, merger or majority equity transfer) absent Licensor's written consent, with Licensor deemed to withhold reasonably if the acquirer competes with it or if it merely believes its interests are adversely affected — i.e. a Vendor exit right triggered by our change of control, expressly walk-away under the rule and far below the fallback. Redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out, applies a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld consent standard with a no-competitor limit on Licensor assignment, removes the cross-reference that would subordinate the carve-out to Article XX, and converts the change-of-control termination into a 30-day notice obligation (the CHANGE OF CONTROL definition is preserved). Noted but not separately flagged: Article XXII gives Licensor a right of first refusal over our sale/merger, which is a related restriction on our exit and may warrant review under a separate rule.

proposal.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment carve-out for Licensee, make consent standard reasonable and mutual, and remove automatic termination on Licensee change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added the customary carve-out allowing us to assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, made any other consent subject to a reasonableness standard on both sides, and removed the automatic termination of the Agreement on our change of control (replaced with notice). Our playbook does not permit a vendor exit or re-pricing right triggered by our corporate transactions.

ops.newText: Licensee may assign this Agreement, without Licensor's consent, to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets. Otherwise, Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed. Licensor may not assign this Agreement without Licensee's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Licensee.
